Messages.Author: Khaleph Alendis
Messages.Body:
One of my vampire play a Kine Resources Contested.
My prey attempt to block with playing Spirit's Touch
I play Lost in Crowds at superior, and the action is not blocked.

I said how the blood will be lost by the other player.

Only after that, one of the player want to cancel my action Kine
Resources Contested with a Direct Intervention.

Can he do that ?

I think it’s too late, because the action is already successful, but
would like an official answer.

Bye,

Khaleph Alendis, High Priest of Maizerets
VEKN Setite Prince of Beauport
http://www.oricom.ca/melkor/khaleph/

Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Khaleph Alendis wrote:
>
> One of my vampire play a Kine Resources Contested.
> My prey attempt to block with playing Spirit's Touch
> I play Lost in Crowds at superior, and the action is not blocked.
>
> I said how the blood will be lost by the other player.
>
> Only after that, one of the player want to cancel my action Kine
> Resources Contested with a Direct Intervention.
>
> Can he do that ?
>

> I think it?s too late, because the action is already successful, but

> would like an official answer.

No. An action card (like KRC) can be canceled by Direct Intervention
only when the action is announced - before any block attempts and certainly
before the resolution of the action.
